description: This is a Java source file defining the StatusDetailMessage class, which encapsulates a status message with a severity level (INFO, WARN, ERROR) and associated message content. It provides methods for creating instances, serializing to JSON, and deserializing from JSON.

classes.name: StatusDetailMessage
classes.description: A class representing a detailed status message with severity level and message content. Implements Jsonifiable for JSON serialization.

classes.name: StatusDetailMessage.Level
classes.description: Enum representing the severity level of the status message: INFO, WARN, ERROR. Default is INFO.

methods.name: StatusDetailMessage.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a StatusDetailMessage with specified level and message string or JsonValue.

methods.name: StatusDetailMessage.warn
methods.description: Creates a warning message, optionally with a Throwable's message.

methods.name: StatusDetailMessage.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the status message to a JsonObject.

methods.name: StatusDetailMessage.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into a StatusDetailMessage, expecting exactly one field indicating level and message.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the severity level of the message.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message content as a JsonValue.
